main_text.l: variis variarum scholarum libris disperfa sunt,
disputata etiam, neq; tamé ab eo descripta: imó
verò quæcunq; pro assidua & fraterna consue-
tudine ex eo audivi ac didici. Atq; id P. Ramo
primum restituendæ & reformandę Dialecticæ
fundamentum propositum erit: secundum autem
erit in exemplis & artis, & artificiosæ commen-
tationis, id est, in usu artis & fructu demonstran-
do. Exempla verò poetarum & oratorum á P. Ra-
mo multorum annorum professione & labore ob-
servata & animadversa equidem plurimi facio,
quia demonstrat artis & veritatem & utilitatē.
Hippocrates, Leo, Theudius, Hermotimus, Eu-
clides, mathematicorum elementorum authores
perhibentur: non quia elementa ipsa invenisse,
sed quia facilius demonstrasse existimantur. At
qui demonstratio logicorum theorematum vera &
germana fit per exepla præstantium logicorum.
Tota logica legitimè descripta definitionib.
& partitionib. coponitur: quę quia principia sunt,
aliam quàm insigniū exemplorū demonstratio
nè non recipiūt: Et sic ἐμπειρία, ἱστορία, διὰ δνσις,
ἐπαγωγὴ, experiētia, observatio, sensus, inductio (ut A-
ristot. 14. cap 1. Post & in Philosophia 1. cap. 1.
li. bri profitetur) omnium artiū theorematā pepe-
rērūt. Quamobré nobilibus exēplis, variis præ-
sertim ac disparibus, variasq; præstantium inge-
niorū dotes in unā doctrinę gloriā veluti cōspi-
rantiū demōstrationibus tantū tribuo, quantū
accuratisimæ demonstrationi logicæ artis tri-
bui posfit. Exempla verò poetica & oratoria P.
Ramus ad illustrandū & demonstrandū logic-
æ artis

page.notes: Line numbers 5–30 in the left margin are marginal line markers, not text. Greek words in the passage (ἐμπειρία, ἱστορία, διδυνσις, ἐπαγωγή) are reproduced approximately from a small, blurred print; the line "Et sic" and the Greek are uncertain. The word "artis" at the foot is a catchword-like line set at right and is treated as the final word of the text. Several words are uncertain due to print quality and are not individually marked.
